subject: literacy
concept: Writing a comparative literary essay analyzing a universal theme across two works from different cultural traditions, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their essay using a shared-theme/cultural-context/treatment-comparison organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes a comparative essay analyzing a shared theme across two culturally distinct literary works

assessment.mastery_threshold: essay identifies a genuine shared theme, addresses each work's cultural context, and compares their distinct treatments with textual evidence
misconception_flags: summarizes two works separately without genuinely comparing their treatment of the shared theme

interest_binding: works generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
